check.description: Write nothing; exit 1 for files sync would write or delete, or for read failures. Left-alone user entries, including oversized SKILL.md files at Forge's skill paths, are listed in skipped with a warning and kept untouched. To repair generated-file drift, run forge skills sync; it overwrites edits to generated files.

dir.description: Override adapter skills directories with this project-relative directory; defaults to enabled adapters' skills dirs, or .agents/skills without adapters.
